content:
[Intro]
[A5]I, I
forget my own
rules
But I still
know
The
end of the sto-

[Verse 1]
[A5]ry
What's
happened to the world,
What's happened
to my life?
There was a time
I felt safe
From the
drossiness
Safe from
discomfort
No enemies,
no lies

[Chorus]
[F5]Where is my soul?
[G5]Where are my ways, where is my
[A]heart?
[Am]  [G]
[F5]Over years it made me weak
[G5]Made me weak

[Bridge]
[A5]
(me unpredictable)

[Interlude]
[A5]Something came across my way
It changed too many things
Inside me (inside me)
Inside

[Verse 2]
[A5]me
Over years it made me weak
I saw your smile
Everything around me seems to glow,
But everything I touch goes out
(Goes out)

[Breakdown]
[A5]
I
hold your hand,
feel your breath, See your smile I
took this gift from life
Not
knowing what awaits me

[Chorus]
[F5]Where is my soul?
[G5]Where are my ways, where is my
[A]heart?
[Am]  [G]
[F5]Over years it made me weak
[G5][C5]Made [G5]me weak

[Pre-Outro]
[A5]Another step in an unknown direction
How can I be sure, Oh how can I be sure?
Days go by, it seems to grow (It seems to
grow) It feels still right, it feels still right

[Outro]
[A5]Where I am Can't see you anymore,
Feel you anymore These voices are [C5]pushing [G5][A5]
[A5]me They want me to fail
[G5]
[A5]I am falling
Nothing to lose, nothing to [C5]win [G5][A5]
[A5]How could I be sure?
Why so sure, why so [G5]sure? [C5][G5]
[A5]
title: Scissorhands
tuning: A E A D F# B
